Session expired

Neconyan sent back an invalid CSRF token, so the page's saved token went stale. Reloading usually fixes it; the steps below cover the rest.

  1. 1Reload the page first. Neconyan repairs a stale token by itself, so a plain refresh often lands you right back in.
  2. 2Still refused after reloading? Close this tab and open the site again: a long-lived tab can keep an old token, reported to the server as Invalid CSRF token.
  3. 3Every page failing? Clear this site's cookies and cached data, or try a private window, then log in again.
  4. 4Still failing in every browser? On the server, run sudo systemctl restart neconyan to mint fresh server state.
  5. 5Old bookmark? Open the exact URL you normally use, for example https://neconyan.purabunny.cc.
  6. 6An extension or script blocking requests? Disable it for this site and reload once more.
